parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. Leave this parameter empty for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

parameters.name: RuleContent
parameters.description: The content of the scene orchestration interaction rule. For details about the format, see [Scene orchestration rule syntax](~~171059~~).

parameters.name: RuleDescription
parameters.description: The description of the scene orchestration interaction rule. The description can be up to 100 characters in length.

parameters.name: RuleName
parameters.description: The name of the scene orchestration interaction rule. The name can contain Chinese characters, letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must be 1 to 30 characters in length.
